hero.headline: Reliability at Scale
hero.subheadline: We deliver 99.9%+ uptime by combining Tier II baseline infrastructure with simplified Tier III redundancies for critical power and cooling.

sections.title: Engineered for AI Continuity
sections.body: Traditional Tier IV data centers are often over-engineered for AI workloads, leading to unnecessarily high CAPEX and rental rates. Kenya AI Compute utilizes an optimized 'Tier II+' design. This means we maintain N+1 redundancy on all critical systems (UPS, cooling, power generation) while avoiding the excessive costs of full concurrent maintainability where it isn't required for machine learning tasks. Since AI training and rendering tasks are naturally fault-tolerant at the software level, our design provides the perfect balance of 99.9% uptime and low cost-per-watt. For clients requiring higher levels of security, we offer specialized racks that meet full Tier III elements, ensuring that mission-critical inference APIs remain online even during maintenance windows. Additional context: the project follows a clear rollout roadmap that aligns low-cost energy, infrastructure reliability, and flexible deployment models.
